Topics.TitleEn: Websites vs Web Applications & Client-Server
Topics.TitleAr: الفرق بين Website و Web App ونموذج Client-Server
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ Static Website بيعرض محتوى ثابت لكل المستخدمين (HTML/CSS)، بينما الـ Web Application تفاعلي ومتصل بـ Database وبيغير محتواه حسب كل مستخدم.
• الكلاينت (Browser/Mobile) بيبعت HTTP Request للسيرفر، والسيرفر بيعمل Processing على الـ Backend ويرجع Response (HTML في MVC أو JSON في Web API).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Website: content-focused, mostly read-only; Web Application: interactive workflows, auth, DB state.
• Client/Server model relies on request-response cycle over HTTP(S).
• Backend handles business rules, validation, persistence, and security.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Confusing frontend browser execution (HTML/CSS/JS) with backend server execution (C# / SQL).
• Assuming client-side validation replaces server-side validation.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What is the difference between a Website and a Web Application?
• Why choose ASP.NET Core for backend development?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Client initiates requests; Server processes business logic & DB and returns responses.
Generates user-specific content backed by server logic and database persistence.

Topics.TitleEn: Value vs Reference Types & Stack vs Heap
Topics.TitleAr: الفرق بين Value Type و Reference Type والـ Stack vs Heap
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ CLR بيقسم الميموري لـ Stack (سريع، LIFO، متغيرات محلية و Value Types و References) و Heap (كبير، Reference Types، بينضفه الـ Garbage Collector).
• الـ Value Types (زي int, double, struct, enum) بتتخزن قيمتها مباشرة ونسخها بيعمل Bitwise Copy مستقل.
• الـ Reference Types (زي class, string, array, interface, delegate) بتحط الـ Object في الـ Heap والـ Reference (العنوان) في الـ Stack، ونسخها بينسخ العنوان مش الكائن.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Stack: LIFO frames, deterministic cleanup on scope exit, holds value types and object reference pointers.
• Heap: dynamic allocation managed asynchronously by Garbage Collector (GC).
• Assigning Value Types clones data independently; assigning Reference Types copies the address pointer.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Thinking every struct lives ONLY on the stack: a struct field inside a class lives inside that class's Heap block!
• Assuming `ref` parameter vs reference type are the same thing.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare Stack vs Heap in .NET CLR.
• Where is an `int` field declared inside a `class` stored?
• Explain what Garbage Collector does and when heap memory is reclaimed.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Derives from System.ValueType (struct, enum, primitives); assignment copies data by value.
Allocates payload on Heap; Stack variable holds address pointer; assignment copies pointer.
Non-deterministically frees unreachable Heap objects across Generations (Gen 0/1/2).
Local variables & parameters use camelCase; classes, methods, namespaces, properties use PascalCase.

Questions.Prompt: What is printed by: Point p1 = new Point(5, 10); Point p2 = p1; p2.X = 100; Console.WriteLine(p1.X); (where Point is a struct)?
Questions.Explanation: Point is a struct (Value Type). Copying p1 to p2 creates an independent bitwise copy on the stack.

Questions.Prompt: Person p1 = new Person { Name = "Sara" }; Person p2 = p1; p2.Name = "Mona"; — What is p1.Name?
Questions.Explanation: Person is a class (Reference Type). Copying p1 to p2 copies only the Heap address pointer, so both point to the same instance.

Questions.Prompt: If a class `Order` declares `public int Quantity;`, is `Quantity` stored on the Stack or Heap?
Questions.CorrectAnswer: On the Heap (inside the Order object instance allocation), though int is a Value Type.
Questions.Explanation: Value types declared as fields inside a Reference Type live inline within that object's Heap allocation, whereas local Value Type variables live on the Stack.

Topics.TitleEn: System.Object, Casting, Convert/TryParse & Boxing
Topics.TitleAr: كلاس System.Object والـ Casting والـ Boxing & Unboxing
Topics.SummaryAr:
• كل الأنواع في C# بتورث من System.Object (4 ميثودز أساسية: ToString, Equals, GetHashCode, GetType).
• Boxing: تحويل Value Type لـ object (نقل نسخة للـ Heap - تقيل). Unboxing: رجوعها لـ Value Type بـ Explicit Cast ولازم نفس النوع وإلا يضرب InvalidCastException.
• في التحويل: Parse بتضرب FormatException، Convert.ToInt32 بتحول null لصفر، والأأمن دايما int.TryParse.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Every type inherits `System.Object` (`ToString`, `Equals`, `GetHashCode`, `GetType`).
• Boxing wraps Value Type on Heap inside `object`; Unboxing extracts it with an explicit exact-type cast.
• Prefer `TryParse` for user input, `is`/`as` for safe reference casting.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Casting `(double)boxedInt` after boxing an `int` throws `InvalidCastException` — must unbox to exact type `(int)boxedInt` first.
• Overriding `Equals()` without overriding `GetHashCode()` breaks Dictionary/HashSet behavior.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What is Boxing/Unboxing and how do Generics eliminate it?
• Compare `int.Parse`, `Convert.ToInt32`, and `int.TryParse` on `null` and `"abc"`.
• Compare `is` vs `as` casting.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Implicit conversion from Value Type to object/interface; allocates wrapper on Heap.
Explicit cast from object back to exact original Value Type; throws InvalidCastException if wrong type.
Returns bool instead of throwing FormatException; safely handles invalid user input.
'x as T' returns null on mismatch (ref/nullable only); '(T)x' throws InvalidCastException.
Convert.ToInt32(null) returns 0; int.Parse(null) throws ArgumentNullException.

Topics.TitleEn: Operators, Control Flow & String vs StringBuilder
Topics.TitleAr: المعاملات والتحكم في التدفق و String vs StringBuilder
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ `string` في C# هو Reference Type لكنه Immutable (أي تعديل بيعمل Object جديد في الـ Heap). جوه الـ Loops استخدم `StringBuilder` علشان متعملش ضغط على الـ GC.

Mutable char buffer for multi-step/loop concatenation without heap churn.

Topics.TitleEn: Arrays (1D/2D/Jagged), Nullable Types & ref/out/in/params
Topics.TitleAr: المصفوفات والـ Nullable والـ Parameters Passing (ref/out/in/params)
Topics.SummaryAr:
• Rectangular Array `int[,]`: صفوف وأعمدة ثابتة في كتلة واحدة. Jagged Array `int[][]`: مصفوفة مصفوفات كل صف بطول مختلف.
• Nullable Value Type `int?` اختصار لـ `Nullable<int>` (`HasValue`, `Value`).
• `??` Null-Coalescing و `??=` Null-Coalescing Assignment و `?.` Null-Conditional.
• `ref`: لازم متغير متعرف مسبقا وممكن يتعدل. `out`: الميثود ملزمة تديله قيمة قبل ما تخرج. `in`: للقراءة فقط بدون نسخ Struct كبير.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Rectangular `[r, c]` vs Jagged `[][]` arrays.
• Nullable syntax (`T?`, `?.`, `??`, `??=`, null-forgiving `!`).
• Parameter modifiers: `ref` (in+out, initialized before call), `out` (output only, assigned inside), `in` (readonly ref), `params` (variable args array/collection).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Passing a reference type by value vs `ref` (by-val copy allows mutating object properties, `ref` allows reassigning the caller's variable itself).
• Forgetting to assign every `out` parameter before returning.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Difference between passing a Reference Type by value vs by `ref`?
• Compare `ref`, `out`, `in`, and `params`.
• Compare 2D `int[,]` vs Jagged `int[][]`.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Wraps a value type so it can hold null; exposes .HasValue and .Value.
?? returns right-hand fallback if left is null; ??= assigns only when null.
'ref' requires caller initialization before call; 'out' must be assigned inside the method.
Must be the last parameter; lets caller pass comma-separated args or an array.

Topics.TitleEn: Enums, Bitwise [Flags] Permissions & Exception Handling
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Enum وصلاحيات الـ [Flags] وإدارة الأخطاء try/catch/finally
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ `enum` نوع Value Type بيخزن ثوابت مسماة (بتبدأ من 0 وبتزيد 1). مع `[Flags]` بنستخدم مضاعفات الاتنين (1, 2, 4, 8) ونجمع بالـ `|` ونشيك بـ `&` أو `HasFlag`.
• في `try/catch/finally`: الـ Exception المحدد ييجي قبل العام `Exception`، وبلوك `finally` بيتنفذ دايما لإغلاق الـ Resources.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `enum` maps named integral constants (default `int`). With `[Flags]` use powers of two (`1, 2, 4, 8`) with bitwise `|`, `&`, `^`, `~`.
• `try-catch-finally`: specific exception handlers must precede general `Exception`; `finally` always runs for cleanup.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Putting sequential enum values `1, 2, 3, 4` on a `[Flags]` enum (`3 = 1 | 2` collides!).
• Catching `Exception` before specific child exceptions (compile error CS0160).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Why use powers of 2 with `[Flags]` enums?
• Does `finally` run if there is a `return` statement inside `try`? (Yes!)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Bitmask enum whose values are powers of 2 (1,2,4,8) combined via '|' and tested via '&' or HasFlag.
More specific exception types MUST appear before base System.Exception.
Guaranteed cleanup block even on exception or early return; 'using' compiles to try-finally Dispose().

Topics.TitleEn: Structs vs Classes, Access Modifiers & Encapsulation
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Struct vs Class ومحددات الوصول والـ Encapsulation
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ `class` Reference Type بيقبل الوراثة وموجود في الـ Heap، بينما الـ `struct` Value Type ما بيورثش (ممكن يطبق Interface بس) ومناسب للبيانات الصغيرة (< 16 bytes).
• محددات الوصول الـ 6: `private` (default جوه class/struct), `internal` (default للـ top-level class/struct), `protected`, `public`, `protected internal`, `private protected` (وزيادة `file` في C# 11).
• التغليف (Encapsulation): إخفاء الـ private fields وتنظيم الوصول عبر Properties (`get`/`set`/`init`) مع Validation.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `struct` = Value type, no class inheritance (can implement interfaces); `class` = Reference type, full inheritance.
• Default modifiers: `internal` for top-level types, `private` for members.
• Encapsulation uses private backing fields + validated properties (`get`, `set`, `init`).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Making public mutable fields instead of properties (breaks encapsulation and data binding).
• Confusing `protected internal` (OR: same assembly OR subclass anywhere) with `private protected` (AND: same assembly AND subclass).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• List all C# access modifiers and the defaults for classes vs class members vs interface members.
• Difference between `struct` and `class` (inheritance, nullability, memory, parameterless constructor).
• What is `init` property accessor?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Top-level type defaults to internal; class/struct members default to private; interface members default to public.
protected internal = protected OR internal; private protected = protected AND internal (same assembly subclasses only).
Allows setting property only during object initialization/constructor, then becomes read-only (C# 9).

Topics.TitleEn: Constructors Chaining, Indexers & Operator Overloading
Topics.TitleAr: تسلسل الـ Constructors والـ Indexers وزيادة تحميل المعاملات
Topics.SummaryAr:
• Constructor Chaining: استخدام `: this(...)` لمناداة Constructor في نفس الكلاس، و `: base(...)` لمناداة Constructor الأب (الأب بيتنفذ الأول دايما!).
• Indexer (`public string this[int index]`): بيخليك تتعامل مع الكائن كأنه Array بالـ `[]`. ممنوع يكون `static`، ولو حطيت access modifier يتكتب على `get` أو `set` واحد بس مش الاتنين.
• Operator Overloading (`public static Complex operator +(Complex a, Complex b)`).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Constructor Chaining (`: this(...)`, `: base(...)`): base class constructor always executes BEFORE derived constructor body.
• Indexers (`this[index]`): enable array-like `obj[key]` syntax; NEVER `static`; access modifier allowed on at most ONE accessor.
• Operator overloading must be `public static`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Trying to declare an indexer as `static` (compile error!).
• Adding access modifiers on BOTH `get` and `set` of a single property/indexer.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• In inheritance, which constructor runs first: Base or Derived?
• State the rules for C# Indexers.
• How do you overload `==` in C#? (Must also overload `!=`, and typically `Equals`/`GetHashCode`.)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Declared with 'this[T idx]'; CANNOT be static; access modifier on max one accessor (get OR set).
Parent constructor ALWAYS runs before derived constructor body.
Must be 'public static operator +(...)'; overloading '==' requires overloading '!='.

Topics.TitleEn: OOP Relationships: Association, Aggregation, Composition & Inheritance
Topics.TitleAr: علاقات الكلاسات: Association, Aggregation, Composition, Inheritance
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Association (Uses-A / Interacts)**: علاقة عامة زي Doctor و Patient.
• **Aggregation (Weak Has-A)**: الأب بيحتوي الابن لكن لو الأب اتمسح الابن يفضل عايش (Department و Employee - الابن يتبعت في Constructor أو Property).
• **Composition (Strong Has-A / Part-Of)**: لو الكل اتمسح الجزء يموت معاه (House و Room - الجزء بيتعمله `new` جوه الكل أو ماينفعش يعيش لوحده).
• **Inheritance (Is-A)**: وراثة صفات وسلوك الأب (`class Dog : Animal`) — C# بتدعم Single Class Inheritance و Multiple Interface Implementation.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Dependency: temporary parameter usage.
• Association: loose peer reference.
• Aggregation (Weak Has-A): independent lifecycle (passed via constructor/setter).
• Composition (Strong Has-A): child lifecycle owned by parent.
• Inheritance (Is-A): single base class inheritance in C#.
Topics.CommonMistakes: • Inheriting just for code reuse when the relationship isn't a true IS-A (prefer Composition over Inheritance!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Explain the difference between Aggregation and Composition with code examples.
• Why does C# forbid multiple class inheritance? (Diamond Problem!)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Parent owns child lifetime; child created inside parent and destroyed with it.
Container holds references to parts created externally with independent lifetimes.
A C# class can inherit from at most ONE class, though it can implement multiple interfaces.

Topics.TitleEn: Polymorphism: Compile-Time (Static) vs Runtime (Dynamic Binding)
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Polymorphism والفرق بين new و virtual/override والـ Binding
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Static Polymorphism (Early Binding)**: بيتحدد وقت الـ Compile حسب نوع الـ Reference/Variable! يشمل Method Overloading والـ Method Hiding بـ `new`.
• **Dynamic Polymorphism (Late Binding)**: بيتحدد وقت الـ Runtime حسب نوع الـ Object الفعلي في الـ Heap عبر الـ V-Table! بيحصل بـ `virtual` في الأب + `override` في الابن.
• لو عملت `Parent obj = new Child();`: مع `new` ينادي Parent، ومع `override` ينادي Child!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Static (Compile-Time): resolved by reference variable type (Method Overloading, `new` Method Hiding).
• Dynamic (Runtime): resolved by actual Heap object type via V-Table (`virtual` + `override`, `abstract`, interfaces).
• Golden Rule: `Parent p = new Child(); p.Method()` -> Look at reference type for `new`, look at Heap object for `override`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Thinking `new` overrides the base method polymorphically.
• Forgetting `virtual` on the base method when wanting `override` in child.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Explain Static Binding (`new`) vs Dynamic Binding (`virtual`/`override`).
• What happens when overriding a `virtual` method and hiding it further down with `new`?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Enables Dynamic Binding (runtime dispatch via Heap object's actual type).
Breaks polymorphism; Static Binding resolves strictly from the reference variable type.
Same method name with different parameter count/types/order in same/derived scope (return type alone is NOT enough).

Topics.TitleEn: Abstraction: Abstract Classes vs Interfaces
Topics.TitleAr: التجريد Abstraction والفرق بين Abstract Class و Interface
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ **Abstract Class**: ينفع يحتوي Fields و Constructors و Concrete Methods + Abstract Methods، الكلاس يورث واحد بس منه، ولا يمكن تعمل `new` منه مباشرة.
• الـ **Interface**: عقد (Contract) بدون Instance Fields ولا Constructors (تقدر تضيف Default Methods من C# 8+ و Static Members)، الكلاس أو الـ Struct يقدر يطبق اكتر من Interface.
• Explicit Interface Implementation يحل مشكلة تصادم اسماء الميثودز بين اتنين Interface.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Abstract class: shared partial implementation, fields, constructors, single inheritance.
• Interface: capability contract (`IMovable`, `IComparable`), multiple implementation, works on classes & structs.
• Explicit implementation hides interface method from direct class reference unless cast to the interface.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Trying to instantiate `new Shape()` on an abstract class.
• Putting `public` explicitly on an explicit interface implementation `public void IPrintable.Print()` (syntax error!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare Abstract Class vs Interface (10 points: fields, constructors, multiple inheritance, structs, access modifiers, purpose).
• When do you use Explicit Interface Implementation?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Abstract = shared IS-A base (fields+ctors+single inherit); Interface = CAN-DO capability contract (multiple+structs).
'void IFoo.Bar()' resolves naming conflicts; only callable via interface reference ((IFoo)obj).Bar().
Interfaces in C# always start with capital 'I' (IDisposable, IComparable, IEntityTypeConfiguration).

Topics.TitleEn: Sealed, Static, Partial, Shallow vs Deep Copy & Exam 02
Topics.TitleAr: كلمات sealed و static و partial والـ Deep/Shallow Copy وامتحان OOP
Topics.SummaryAr:
• `sealed class`: بيمنع أي كلاس يورث منه. `sealed override`: بيمنع الـ Child أنه يعمل `override` تاني.
• `static class`: كل أعضائه static ومينفعش تعمل `new` منه. Static Constructor بيتنفذ مرة واحدة بس أول ما الكلاس يتحمل في الميموري.
• Shallow Copy (`MemberwiseClone`): بينسخ الـ Value Types وبيشارك الـ Reference fields. Deep Copy (`ICloneable` + Copy Constructor): بينسخ الـ References بالكامل.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `sealed` locks inheritance/overriding; `partial` splits one class across multiple `.cs` files (used heavily by EF Core DbContext & Scaffold-DbContext).
• Shallow copy shares inner reference objects; Deep copy / Copy Constructor duplicates nested state.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Passing arguments or access modifier (`public`) to a `static` constructor (compile error!).
• Assuming `ICloneable` guarantees Deep Copy (you must implement the deep copy logic yourself!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What happens when you mark a class `sealed` vs an overridden method `sealed override`?
• Static Class vs Singleton Pattern?
• Shallow Copy vs Deep Copy?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: 'sealed class' forbids inheritance; 'sealed override' allows inheritance of class while blocking further overrides.
Parameterless, no access modifier; runs automatically ONCE before first static access or instance creation.
Splits a single class across multiple files; merged at compile time (used by EF scaffolding & Razor).

Topics.TitleEn: Generics <T>, Constraints, Variance & Equality
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Generics والـ Constraints و الـ Covariance/Contravariance
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ Generics بتديك Type Safety وقت الـ Compile وبتلغي الحاجة للـ Boxing/Unboxing.
• Generic Constraints بـ `where T : ...` زي `class`, `struct`, `new()`, `BaseClass`, `IMyInterface`.
• `default(T)` بترجع null للـ Reference و 0 للـ Value Type.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Generics eliminate boxing overhead and enforce compile-time type safety.
• Constraints: `where T : class | struct | new() | notnull | IInterface | BaseClass`.
• Variance on interfaces/delegates: `out T` (Covariance - return), `in T` (Contravariance - parameter).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Writing `T == null` directly without constraints when comparing generic values — use `EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(a, b)` instead.
• Placing `new()` before `class` constraint (`new()` MUST be last!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Why are `List<int>` and `Dictionary<K,V>` much faster than `ArrayList` and `Hashtable`?
• What is the order rule for multiple generic constraints?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Constrains generic T to ref types with a public parameterless ctor; 'new()' must ALWAYS be listed last.
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: class Repo<T> where T : class, new()

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Avoids boxing when comparing generic values cleanly across value & reference types.

Topics.TitleEn: Generic Collections Architecture & Big-O Complexity
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Collections المتقدمة وتعقيد Big-O للـ List / Dictionary / HashSet
Topics.SummaryAr:
• `List<T>` (Dynamic Array): وصول بالـ Index بـ `O(1)` وبحث عن قيمة بـ `O(n)`، والـ `RemoveAt` بيزحزح العناصر (Index shifting!).
• `Dictionary<K,V>`: Hash Table مفاتيح فريدة و Lookup `O(1)`. استعمل `TryGetValue` بدل `ContainsKey + [k]`، و `dict[k] = v` بدل `Add` عشان متضربش `ArgumentException`.
• `HashSet<T>`: مجموعة قيم فريدة `O(1)` لـ `UnionWith`/`IntersectWith`.
• `Queue<T>` (FIFO) و `Stack<T>` (LIFO) — `Pop()`/`Peek()` على فاضي يضرب `InvalidOperationException`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `List<T>`: O(1) by index, O(n) value search; removing an index shifts subsequent elements backward.
• `Dictionary<K,V>`: O(1) avg hash lookup; `Add` throws on duplicate key, `TryGetValue` avoids double hashing.
• `HashSet<T>`: strictly unique elements + fast set algebra.
• `Queue<T>` (FIFO) vs `Stack<T>` (LIFO).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `dict.Add(existingKey, val)` instead of `dict[existingKey] = val` or `TryAdd`.
• Calling `stack.Pop()` or `queue.Dequeue()` without checking `Count > 0` or using `TryPop`/`TryDequeue`.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `List<T>` vs `LinkedList<T>` vs `HashSet<T>` vs `Dictionary<K,V>` in Big-O complexity.
• Why should custom Dictionary keys implement `Equals` AND `GetHashCode` properly?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Performs hash lookup once; avoids throwing KeyNotFoundException or double-hashing with ContainsKey.
Deleting element at index i shifts all trailing items backward O(n) and renumbers indices.
Calling Pop()/Dequeue()/Peek() on empty collection throws InvalidOperationException.

Topics.TitleEn: Delegates, Built-In Func/Action/Predicate, Lambdas & Events
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Delegates والـ Func/Action/Predicate والـ Lambda والـ Events
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ Delegate هو Type-safe pointer لميثود (بيورث من `MulticastDelegate`).
• الـ Built-in Delegates بتغنيك عن تعريف delegate مخصص: `Action<T>` (فويد لحد 16 باراميتر)، `Func<T, TResult>` (بترجع قيمة)، `Predicate<T>` (بترجع `bool`).
• الفرق بين `event` و `delegate`: الـ `event` بيحط طبقة Encapsulation تمنع الكود الخارجي يعمل `=` يمسح كل الـ subscribers أو يعمل `Invoke` من بره.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Delegates hold references to methods safely and support multicast (`+=`, `-=`).
• Standard delegates: `Action<...>` (`void`), `Func<..., TResult>` (last generic arg is return type), `Predicate<T>` (`bool`).
• `event` restricts external code to `+=` and `-=` only (cannot overwrite `=` or invoke outside declaring class).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Writing `delegate` field directly instead of `event` (external code can accidentally overwrite all listeners with `=`!).
• Capturing a loop variable inside a lambda closure without copying inside the loop body (C# < 5 gotcha).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `Action`, `Func`, and `Predicate`.
• Why use `event` keyword instead of exposing a public `delegate` field?
• What happens if a multicast delegate with a non-void return type is invoked? (Returns value of the LAST subscribed method!)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Func<..., Out> returns a value (last T); Action<...> returns void; Predicate<T> returns bool.
External callers can only subscribe (+=) or unsubscribe (-=); cannot clear (=) or Invoke() directly.

Topics.TitleEn: Extension Methods, Anonymous Types, ValueTuples & Records
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Extension Methods والـ Anonymous Types والـ Tuples و Records
Topics.SummaryAr:
• Extension Method لازم تبقى جوه `static class` وتكون `static method` وأول باراميتر فيها `this TargetType x`.
• Anonymous Types `new { Name = "A" }`: Immutable، تقارن بالـ Value في `Equals`، ومفيدة جدا مع LINQ `Select`.
• `record` (C# 9+): Value-based equality + Non-destructive mutation عبر `with`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Extension Methods: `static` method inside non-nested non-generic `static class` with `this T` first parameter.
• Anonymous Types: read-only compiler-generated class used heavily in projections; use `var`.
• `record`: immutable reference/value types with built-in value equality & `with` expressions.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Defining an extension method inside a generic or nested class (compile error CS1106/CS1109).
• Assuming `class` compares properties on `Equals` like `record` does.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Rules for writing an Extension Method in C#?
• Compare `class` vs `record` vs `struct` on equality and mutability.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Must be static method in top-level non-generic static class; first arg prefixed with 'this'.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Records compare by property VALUES rather than reference address; support 'with' cloning.

Topics.TitleEn: Multithreading: Thread, ThreadPool, Race Conditions, lock, Interlocked & Deadlock
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Multithreading ومشاكل Race Condition والـ lock و Deadlock
Topics.SummaryAr:
• Process برنامج شغال بميموري مستقلة؛ جواه Threads بتتشارك نفس الـ Heap Memory!
• Foreground Thread بيخلي الـ Process صاحي لحد ما يخلص؛ Background Thread بيموت أول ما آخر Foreground (زي Main) يخلص.
• `count++` مش Atomic -> بيعمل Race Condition! الحل: `lock(_gate)` لبلوك كود أو `Interlocked.Increment(ref count)` لعملية واحدة سريعة.
• Deadlock: Thread 1 ماسك A ومستني B، و Thread 2 ماسك B ومستني A — الحل تثبيت نفس ترتيب الـ Locks!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Threads share process Heap memory while owning separate stacks.
• Foreground vs Background (`IsBackground = true`): process exits once all foreground threads end.
• Synchronization: `lock(obj)` (uses `Monitor.Enter`/`Exit`), `Interlocked.Increment` (atomic CPU ops), `ThreadPool` (reuses worker threads cleanly).
• Avoid deadlocks using consistent lock acquisition ordering.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `lock(this)` or `lock("string")` (external code can lock on the same object -> deadlock! Always `private readonly object _gate = new()`).
• Using `new Thread()` inside high-concurrency web requests instead of `ThreadPool`/`async-await`.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare Process vs Thread.
• Foreground vs Background thread behavior?
• Why is `count++` NOT thread-safe and compare `lock`, `Monitor`, and `Interlocked`?
• How do Deadlocks happen and how do you prevent them?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Lock ONLY on a private readonly object (never lock(this), typeof, or string literals).
Interlocked performs lock-free atomic CPU operations for simple increments/exchanges; lock protects multi-line critical sections.
Always acquire multiple locks in a globally consistent order (Lock A -> Lock B in every thread).
Runtime waits for all Foreground threads before exiting; Background threads terminate immediately when Main exits.

Topics.TitleEn: Asynchronous Programming: async/await, Task & Thread Starvation
Topics.TitleAr: البرمجة غير المتزامنة async/await ومشكلة Thread Starvation
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الفرق الجوهري: Synchronous (`Thread.Sleep` أو Query بدون `Async`) بيحبس الـ Thread بدون شغل (~1 MB stack محجوز على الفاضي) وده بيعمل **Thread Starvation** في السيرفرات.
• `async/await` بيفك الـ Thread وقت انتظار الـ I/O (الداتابيز/الشبكة) ويرجعه للـ ThreadPool يخدم ناس تانية، ولما النتيجة توصل بيكمل الشغل.
• `Task.WhenAll(...)` بيشغل أكتر من I/O Task بالتوازي.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Blocking I/O wastes ThreadPool threads (~1 MB stack each) causing Thread Starvation under load.
• `async`/`await` frees the thread during I/O wait and resumes when awaited Task completes.
• Use `await Task.WhenAll(t1, t2)` for concurrent I/O operations and `CancellationToken` for cooperative abort.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `.Result` or `.Wait()` on an async Task (sync-over-async -> causes Deadlocks & ThreadPool starvation!).
• Using `async void` outside top-level event handlers (unhandled exceptions crash the process!).
• Passing two concurrent EF Core queries on the SAME `DbContext` instance concurrently (`DbContext` is NOT thread-safe!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• How does `async/await` improve ASP.NET Core scalability without making individual DB queries faster?
• Why should you avoid `.Result`, `.Wait()`, and `async void`?
• Compare `Task.WhenAll` vs sequential `await`.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Async methods must end with 'Async' suffix and return Task / Task<T> (never async void).
Never call .Result or .Wait() in ASP.NET Core; use await all the way down.
Awaits multiple independent async tasks concurrently.

Topics.TitleEn: ERD Design: Entities, Attributes, Keys & Participation
Topics.TitleAr: رسم الـ ERD وأنواع الـ Entities والـ Keys والـ Cardinality
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ **Strong Entity** ليه PK مستقل، الـ **Weak Entity** ملوش PK لوحده وبيعتمد على Parent (بـ Double Rectangle + Identifying Relationship) وبياخد PK المركب مع Partial Key.
• أنواع الـ Attributes: Simple vs Composite, Single-Valued vs Multi-Valued (Double Oval), Stored vs Derived (Dashed Oval - زي Age من BirthDate).
• الـ **Candidate Key** كل مفاتيح الصف الفريدة؛ بنختار واحد `Primary Key` والباقي `Alternate Key`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Strong vs Weak Entity (identifying parent PK + partial key).
• Attributes: Simple, Composite, Single/Multi-Valued (`{}` / Double Oval), Derived (Dashed, computed not stored).
• Keys: Super -> Candidate -> Primary (+ Alternate/Unique) -> Foreign Key.
• Relationship Degree (Unary/Binary/Ternary), Cardinality (1:1, 1:M, M:N), Participation (Total/Mandatory vs Partial/Optional).
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Derived attributes (Age) are computed, NOT stored as redundant columns:
SELECT FullName, DATEDIFF(YEAR, BirthDate, GETDATE()) AS Age FROM Employees;
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Storing derived columns (like `TotalPrice` or `Age`) without justification.
• Confusing Total Participation (mandatory FK `NOT NULL`) with Partial Participation (nullable FK).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare Primary Key vs Unique Constraint vs Candidate Key vs Surrogate Key.
• What is a Weak Entity and how is its PK formed?
• Difference between Derived and Multivalued attributes?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Cannot exist without Identifying Parent; gets composite PK = (Parent_PK + Partial_Key).
Total (Mandatory) forces FK to be NOT NULL; Partial (Optional) allows NULL FK.
Dashed oval on ERD; calculated dynamically (e.g., Age from DOB) rather than stored.

Topics.TitleEn: The 8 ERD-to-Relational Schema Mapping Rules
Topics.TitleAr: قواعد التحويل الـ 8 من ERD لـ Database Schema
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **1:1 (Total from ONE side)**: نحط الـ FK جوه الطرف الـ Total ونعمله `NOT NULL UNIQUE`.
• **1:1 (Total from BOTH sides)**: ندمج الجدولين في جدول واحد!
• **1:M**: الـ FK دايما في ناحية الـ **Many**.
• **M:N**: نعمل جدول تالت (Bridge/Junction Table) فيه PK مركب من الاتنين FK + أي Relationship Attributes.
• **Multivalued Attribute**: جدول منفصل (EntityPK + Value).
• **Unary (Self-Reference)**: الـ FK يشاور على نفس الجدول ويبقى Nullable لو فيه Root.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Rule 1: Strong Entity -> Table.
• Rule 2: Weak Entity -> Table with Parent PK as FK forming Composite PK.
• Rule 3: 1:1 (both Total -> merge tables; one Total -> FK on Total side + UNIQUE).
• Rule 4: 1:M -> FK ALWAYS goes to the 'Many' side.
• Rule 5: M:N -> Bridge Table with Composite PK.
• Rule 6: Multivalued -> Separate Table.
• Rule 7: Composite Attribute -> Flatten components as columns.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Mapping M:N with Relationship Attribute (Grade)
CREATE TABLE StudentCourses (
    StudentId INT REFERENCES Students(Id),
    CourseId  INT REFERENCES Courses(Id),
    Grade DECIMAL(5,2),
    PRIMARY KEY (StudentId, CourseId)
);
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Putting FK on the 'One' side of a 1:M relationship (fails — one row can't hold many FK values without breaking 1NF!).
• Forgetting `UNIQUE` constraint on FK in a 1:1 relationship (without `UNIQUE`, it actually becomes 1:M!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• In 1:1 where one side is Total and the other is Partial, where does the FK go and why?
• How do you enforce strict 1:1 at the SQL level? (`FK + UNIQUE` constraint!)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: FK ALWAYS resides on the Dependent ('Many') table.
To turn 1:M FK into strict 1:1, put UNIQUE constraint on the FK column.
Decompose M:N into 2 x (1:M) via Bridge table holding composite PK (FK1, FK2).

Topics.TitleEn: Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF) & Intentional Denormalization
Topics.TitleAr: التطبيع Normalization (1NF/2NF/3NF) والـ Denormalization
Topics.SummaryAr:
• هدف الـ Normalization منع الـ Redundancy و الـ Update/Insert/Delete Anomalies (مناسب جدا لأنظمة OLTP زي البنوك).
• **1NF (Atomic)**: مفيش قيم متعددة في خلية واحدة ولا أعمدة متكررة (زي Phone1, Phone2).
• **2NF (No Partial Dependency)**: في حالة الـ Composite PK، كل الأعمدة لازم تعتمد على المفتاح المركب **كله** مش جزء منه.
• **3NF (No Transitive Dependency)**: مفيش عمود غير مفتاحي يعتمد على عمود غير مفتاحي تاني (A -> B -> C).
• **Denormalization**: كسر القواعد بقصد (تكرار محسوب أو جدول تقارير) لتقليل الـ JOINs وتسريع القراءة في الـ OLAP/Dashboards.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• **1NF**: Atomic single value per cell, no repeating groups.
• **2NF**: 1NF + no Partial Dependency on part of a Composite PK.
• **3NF**: 2NF + no Transitive Dependency (`PK -> NonKeyA -> NonKeyB`).
• **Denormalization**: deliberate redundancy for read-heavy OLAP/reporting dashboards.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Violation of 2NF: Composite PK (OrderId, ProductId) with ProductName
-- ProductName depends ONLY on ProductId (Partial Dependency) -> Move ProductName to Products table!
-- Violation of 3NF: Employees(Id, DeptId, DeptLocation)
-- DeptLocation depends on DeptId (Transitive) -> Move DeptLocation to Departments table!
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Checking 2NF on single-column PK tables (a table in 1NF with a single-column PK is automatically in 2NF!).
• Over-denormalizing transactional write-heavy OLTP tables (banking/inventory), causing inconsistent balances.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Explain 1NF, 2NF, and 3NF with an anomaly example for each.
• When is Denormalization the right engineering choice (OLTP vs OLAP)?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Every cell holds one atomic value; zero lists/arrays/repeating column groups.
Applies to Composite PKs: every non-key column must depend on the ENTIRE composite key.
No non-key attribute determines another non-key attribute (PK -> A -> B forbidden).
OLTP (writes/consistency) -> Normalize to 3NF; OLAP (analytics/reports) -> Selective Denormalization.

Topics.TitleEn: SQL Server Storage Architecture, DDL, Constraints & Cascade Rules
Topics.TitleAr: معمارية التخزين في SQL Server وأوامر DDL والـ Constraints
Topics.SummaryAr:
• SQL Server بيخزن البيانات في ملفات: `.mdf` (Primary)، `.ndf` (Secondary)، `.ldf` (Transaction Log - WAL Write-Ahead Logging). أصغر وحدة تخزين هي الـ **Page (8 KB)** و 8 صفحات يعملوا **Extent (64 KB)**.
• أوامر DDL: `CREATE`, `ALTER`, `DROP`, `TRUNCATE` (الـ Truncate DDL سريع وبيرست الـ `IDENTITY` ومينفعش معاه `WHERE` عكس `DELETE` اللي هو DML).
• الـ Constraints: `PRIMARY KEY`, `FOREIGN KEY` (+ `ON DELETE CASCADE / SET NULL / NO ACTION`), `UNIQUE`, `CHECK`, `DEFAULT`, `NOT NULL`, `IDENTITY(seed, inc)`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Storage files: `.mdf` (Primary), `.ndf` (Secondary), `.ldf` (Write-Ahead Log). 1 Page = 8 KB; 1 Extent = 8 Pages = 64 KB.
• DDL: `CREATE`, `ALTER`, `DROP`, `TRUNCATE`.
• `TRUNCATE` resets `IDENTITY` and cannot have `WHERE` or fire DML triggers; `DELETE` is row-by-row DML.
• FK Cascading rules: `NO ACTION` (default in SQL Server), `CASCADE`, `SET NULL`, `SET DEFAULT`.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
CREATE TABLE Orders (
    Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    CustomerId INT NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT FK_Orders_Customers FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Customers(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    Amount DECIMAL(10,2) CHECK (Amount > 0),
    CreatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT SYSDATETIME()
);
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Assuming SQL `TRUNCATE` fires `AFTER DELETE` triggers (it does NOT!).
• Putting `IDENTITY(1,1)` and trying to insert explicit ID without `SET IDENTITY_INSERT Table ON`.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `DELETE`, `TRUNCATE`, and `DROP` (DDL vs DML, rollback, IDENTITY reset, WHERE, triggers).
• What are `.mdf`, `.ndf`, `.ldf` files, 8 KB Pages, and WAL?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: 8 KB Page is atomic I/O unit; 8 contiguous pages = 64 KB Extent.
DELETE (DML, WHERE, keeps IDENTITY, fires triggers); TRUNCATE (DDL, all rows, resets IDENTITY); DROP (deletes table schema).
Auto-increment column; bypass temporarily using SET IDENTITY_INSERT Tbl ON.

Topics.TitleEn: DML, Three-Valued NULL Logic, TOP WITH TIES & OFFSET-FETCH Paging
Topics.TitleAr: أوامر DML والـ NULL و TOP WITH TIES والترقيم بـ OFFSET-FETCH
Topics.SummaryAr:
• ترتيب كتابة الـ Query غير ترتيب تنفيذه! **ترتيب التنفيذ المنطقي**: `FROM -> JOIN -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> HAVING -> SELECT -> DISTINCT -> ORDER BY -> TOP / OFFSET-FETCH` (عشان كده الـ Alias من SELECT ماينفعش في WHERE بس ينفع في ORDER BY!).
• مع الـ NULL بنستخدم `IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL` مش `= NULL` (Three-Valued Logic: True/False/Unknown)، ونستبدله بـ `ISNULL(col, val)` أو `COALESCE(a, b, c)`.
• للـ Paging من SQL 2012+: `ORDER BY ... OFFSET (@Page-1)*@Size ROWS FETCH NEXT @Size ROWS ONLY` (لازم `ORDER BY`!).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Logical SQL execution order: `FROM -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> HAVING -> SELECT -> DISTINCT -> ORDER BY -> TOP/OFFSET-FETCH`.
• Never compare `= NULL` (always Unknown); use `IS NULL`, `COALESCE(...)`, `ISNULL(...)`.
• `TOP N WITH TIES` includes tied values at Nth position (requires `ORDER BY`).
• ANSI Pagination: `ORDER BY ... OFFSET N ROWS FETCH NEXT M ROWS ONLY`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Using a `SELECT` column alias inside `WHERE` (fails because `WHERE` runs before `SELECT`!).
• Writing `OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY` without `ORDER BY` (syntax error in SQL Server!).
• Writing `WHERE Col <> NULL` instead of `WHERE Col IS NOT NULL`.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What is the logical query processing order in T-SQL, and why can't `WHERE` see aliases from `SELECT`?
• Compare `TOP` vs `TOP WITH TIES` vs `OFFSET-FETCH`.
• Compare `ISNULL` vs `COALESCE`.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: FROM -> JOIN -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> HAVING -> SELECT -> DISTINCT -> ORDER BY -> TOP/OFFSET.
Mandatory ORDER BY; OFFSET (@Page - 1) * @Size ROWS FETCH NEXT @Size ROWS ONLY.
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: ORDER BY Id OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Returns extra rows that share identical ORDER BY key values with the Nth row (requires ORDER BY).

Topics.TitleEn: SQL Joins (INNER, LEFT/RIGHT/FULL, CROSS, SELF), JOIN DML & MERGE
Topics.TitleAr: الـ SQL Joins بكل أنواعها والـ Self Join و MERGE
Topics.SummaryAr:
• `INNER JOIN`: المتطابق في الجدولين بس. `LEFT JOIN`: كل الصفوف من الشمال واللي ملوش مقابل يطلع `NULL`.
• `SELF JOIN`: ربط الجدول بنفسه (مثلا Employee مع Manager عبر `e.ManagerId = m.Id`).
• خد بالك: لو حطيت شرط على الجدول اليمين جوه `WHERE` في `LEFT JOIN` ممكن تقلبه ضمنيا `INNER JOIN`! حطه جوه `ON` لو عايز تحافظ على صفوف الشمال.
• `MERGE` بتعمل Upsert (Insert/Update/Delete) في أمر واحد مقارنة بـ Source و Target.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `INNER`, `LEFT OUTER`, `RIGHT OUTER`, `FULL OUTER`, `CROSS JOIN` (Cartesian), `SELF JOIN`.
• Advanced DML: `UPDATE t SET ... FROM T t JOIN S s ON ...`, `DELETE t FROM T t JOIN ...`, and `MERGE Target USING Source ON ... WHEN MATCHED THEN ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN ...;`.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Self Join (Employee + Manager)
SELECT e.Name AS Employee, ISNULL(m.Name, 'CEO') AS Manager
FROM Employees e
LEFT JOIN Employees m ON e.ManagerId = m.Id;

-- MERGE (requires semicolon at end!)
MERGE INTO Products AS T USING NewPrices AS S ON T.Id = S.Id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.Price = S.Price
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (Id, Price) VALUES (S.Id, S.Price);
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Filtering right-table columns in `WHERE` instead of `ON` during a `LEFT JOIN` (turns it into an `INNER JOIN`!).
• Forgetting the mandatory trailing semicolon `;` on `MERGE` statements.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Write a Self Join to get employees without a manager as well.
• Why does `WHERE rightTbl.Col = 5` break a `LEFT JOIN`?
• Explain `MERGE` statement and its required semicolon.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Putting right-table predicates (except IS NULL) in WHERE converts a LEFT JOIN into an INNER JOIN.
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: LEFT JOIN B ON A.Id=B.AId AND B.Status=1

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Join a table to itself with distinct aliases (e vs m) using FK to own PK.
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: FROM Emp e LEFT JOIN Emp m ON e.MgrId=m.Id

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: SQL Server strictly requires terminating a MERGE statement with a semicolon ';'.

Topics.TitleEn: Aggregate Functions, GROUP BY & WHERE vs HAVING
Topics.TitleAr: دوال التجميع والـ GROUP BY والفرق بين WHERE و HAVING
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الدوال التجميعية (`COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`): كلهم بيتجاهلوا الـ `NULL` ما عدا `COUNT(*)`! ودي خدعة انترفيو مشهورة (`COUNT(*)` غير `COUNT(col)`).
• قاعدة ذهبية: أي عمود موجود في `SELECT` ومش جوه دالة تجميع **لازم** يكون موجود في `GROUP BY`.
• `WHERE` بتفلتر الصفوف **قبل** التجميع (وما تقبلش Aggregates)، بينما `HAVING` بتفلتر المجموعات **بعد** التجميع.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `COUNT(*)` counts rows including NULLs; `COUNT(col)`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX` ignore NULLs.
• Every non-aggregated column in `SELECT` MUST appear in `GROUP BY`.
• `WHERE` filters individual rows pre-grouping; `HAVING` filters groups post-grouping.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
SELECT DepartmentId, COUNT(*) AS EmpCount, AVG(Salary) AS AvgSal
FROM Employees
WHERE IsActive = 1          -- Filters rows BEFORE grouping
GROUP BY DepartmentId
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;     -- Filters groups AFTER grouping
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Putting `WHERE AVG(Salary) > 5000` (illegal! Must be `HAVING`).
• Assuming `AVG(Bonus)` treats NULL as 0 (it skips NULL rows completely — use `AVG(ISNULL(Bonus, 0))` if 0 is intended).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Difference between `COUNT(*)` and `COUNT(column)`?
• Difference between `WHERE` and `HAVING`?
• What does `GROUP BY` return if `SELECT` includes a column not in `GROUP BY`?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: COUNT(*) counts ALL rows including NULLs; COUNT(col) & AVG(col) skip NULLs.
Every non-aggregated expression in SELECT must appear identically in GROUP BY.
WHERE filters raw rows before grouping; HAVING filters aggregated groups after GROUP BY.

Topics.TitleEn: Subqueries, IN vs EXISTS & Set Operators (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT)
Topics.TitleAr: الاستعلامات الفرعية Subqueries و IN vs EXISTS و UNION/EXCEPT
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Subquery** قد يكون Independent (يتنفذ مرة واحدة) أو Correlated (يتنفذ لكل صف من الجدول الخارجي).
• خلي بالك مع **`NOT IN`**: لو الاستعلام الفرعي رجّع قيمة `NULL` واحدة، الـ `NOT IN` كلها هترجع فاضي! استخدم `NOT EXISTS` أأمن وأسرع مع الـ NULLs.
• **Set Operators**: `UNION` (تشيل التكرار وتعمل Sort) vs `UNION ALL` (أسرع - تحتفظ بكل الصفوف)، و `INTERSECT`، و `EXCEPT`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Non-correlated vs Correlated Subqueries.
• `NOT IN` breaks (returns 0 rows) if the subquery contains ANY `NULL`! Prefer `NOT EXISTS` (null-safe + short-circuits on first match).
• `UNION` deduplicates (expensive sort); `UNION ALL` preserves all rows (faster). Same column count & compatible types required.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Using `NOT IN (SELECT ManagerId FROM Employees)` when a CEO has `ManagerId IS NULL` -> returns 0 rows silently!
• Using `UNION` when datasets are already disjoint (unnecessary Distinct Sort cost instead of `UNION ALL`).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `IN` vs `EXISTS` (especially `NOT IN` vs `NOT EXISTS` with `NULL`).
• Compare `UNION` vs `UNION ALL`.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: If subquery returns any NULL, 'WHERE x NOT IN (...)' evaluates to UNKNOWN and returns ZERO rows -> prefer NOT EXISTS.
UNION removes duplicates (requires Distinct Sort); UNION ALL keeps all rows and is significantly faster.

Topics.TitleEn: Window Ranking Functions & Common Table Expressions (CTE)
Topics.TitleAr: دوال الترتيب Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER/RANK/DENSE_RANK) والـ CTE
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ Window Functions بتحسب لكل صف مع الحفاظ على تفاصيل الصفوف عكس `GROUP BY`:
  - `ROW_NUMBER()`: تسلسل مستمر 1,2,3,4 حتى لو متساويين.
  - `RANK()`: لو اتنين تساوي بياخدوا نفس الرقم وينط فجوة (1,2,2,4).
  - `DENSE_RANK()`: نفس الرقم بس بدون فجوة (1,2,2,3) -> ممتاز لـ Top-N salaries.
  - `NTILE(n)`: يقسم لمجموعات متساوية.
• الـ **CTE (`WITH Name AS (...)`)**: نتيجة مؤقتة اسمية بتعيش لـ **أمر SQL واحد فقط** بعدها مباشرة، ومينفعش تفلتر نتيجة الـ Window Function في `WHERE` مباشرة إلا جوه CTE أو Subquery!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `ROW_NUMBER()` (1,2,3,4), `RANK()` (1,2,2,4 gaps), `DENSE_RANK()` (1,2,2,3 no gaps), `NTILE(n)`, `PARTITION BY`.
• Window functions cannot go directly in `WHERE` (windowing runs in SELECT phase) — wrap in a CTE!
• CTE (`WITH CteName AS (...)`) lives strictly for ONE immediately following statement (supports recursive hierarchy queries too!).
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Top 2 Salaries per Department using CTE + DENSE_RANK
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT Name, DeptId, Salary,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DeptId ORDER BY Salary DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Employees
)
SELECT * FROM Ranked WHERE rnk <= 2;
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Writing `WHERE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) = 1` directly (compile error CS/SQL — window functions are only allowed in `SELECT` and `ORDER BY`, wrap in CTE!).
• Trying to `SELECT * FROM MyCTE` TWICE in two separate queries (fails — CTE scope ends after the first statement!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `ROW_NUMBER`, `RANK`, `DENSE_RANK`, and `NTILE` on values `(100, 90, 90, 80)`.
• How do you find the 2nd highest salary per department or delete duplicate rows in SQL Server?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: For ties (90,90): ROW_NUMBER=2,3; RANK=2,2 then 4 (gaps); DENSE_RANK=2,2 then 3 (no gaps).
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Dept ORDER BY Sal DESC)

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: CTE defined via WITH exists ONLY for the single SQL statement immediately following it.

Topics.TitleEn: Temporary Tables (#Temp / ##Global) vs @Table Variables vs CTE
Topics.TitleAr: مقارنة الـ Temp Table (# / ##) و Table Variable (@) و CTE
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **`#LocalTemp`**: متخزن في `tempdb`، مرئي في نفس الـ Session فقط، بيدعم Indexes وإحصائيات (أفضل للبيانات الكبيرة > 1000 صف) وبينمسح أوتوماتيك مع قفل الـ Session.
• **`##GlobalTemp`**: مرئي لكل الـ Sessions وبيدمر لما آخر Session بتستخدمه تقفل.
• **`@TableVariable`**: متغير جدولي بيعيش للـ Batch/SP فقط ومش بيتأثر بـ `ROLLBACK` ومعدوم الإحصائيات غالبا (أفضل للبيانات الصغيرة).
• **`CTE`**: Query alias منطقي لسطر واحد بدون تخزين فعلي إلا عند الحاجة.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `#Temp`: lives in `tempdb` for session duration, supports Indexes & Statistics (best for large data).
• `##Global`: visible across all sessions.
• `@TableVar`: batch/proc scope only, NOT rolled back on transaction ROLLBACK, poor cardinality estimates for big tables.
• `CTE`: single-statement readability/recursion.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Expecting `@TableVariable` changes to roll back when calling `ROLLBACK TRANSACTION` (table variables ignore transaction rollbacks!).
• Using `@TableVar` for 100k+ rows instead of `#Temp` (causes bad nested-loop query plans).
Topics.InterviewQuestions: • Compare CTE vs `#TempTable` vs `##GlobalTemp` vs `@TableVariable` (Scope, Storage, Indexes, Rollback behavior).

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: #Local is private to the creating session in tempdb; ##Global is visible to all sessions until all close.
Changes to @Table variables persist even after ROLLBACK TRANSACTION; #Temp tables DO roll back.

Topics.TitleEn: User-Defined Functions (Scalar/TVF) vs Stored Procedures
Topics.TitleAr: الدوال UDF (Scalar & TVF) مقابل Stored Procedures
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **UDF (Functions)**: لازم ترجع قيمة (Scalar أو Inline TVF أو Multi-Statement TVF)، مينفعش تعمل DML (`INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE`) على جداول الداتابيز، ومينفعش تنادي SP جواها، لكن تقدر تستخدمها جوه `SELECT/WHERE`.
• **Stored Procedure (`CREATE PROC`)**: تقدر تعمل DML و DDL و Output Params و `TRY/CATCH` و Transactions، مش ملزمة ترجع قيمة، وبتحفظ الـ **Execution Plan** (أداء أعلى + حماية من **SQL Injection** لو parameterized).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Functions: Scalar vs Inline Table-Valued (fastest! acts like parameterized view) vs Multi-Statement TVF. Callable inside `SELECT`/`WHERE`; MUST return a value; CANNOT modify permanent DB tables or use `TRY/CATCH`.
• Stored Procedures: pre-compiled cached execution plans, prevent SQL Injection, support DML/DDL/Output params/Transactions/Errors.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling a Scalar UDF inside `WHERE` or `SELECT` over millions of rows (inhibits parallelism / RBAR slowness; Inline TVF with `CROSS APPLY` is way faster).
• Using `EXEC('SELECT ... ' + @input)` dynamic string concat without `sp_executesql` -> SQL Injection risk!
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• List 6 differences between User-Defined Functions (UDF) and Stored Procedures.
• Why are Inline TVFs faster than Multi-Statement TVFs?
• Why use `SET NOCOUNT ON` in Stored Procedures?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Functions must return value, run in SELECT, cannot alter DB state; SPs execute DML/DDL/Transactions & cache plans.
Inline TVF expands directly into caller's query plan (good statistics); Multi-Statement uses @table variable (fixed low row estimate).
Suppresses 'N rows affected' network messages in SPs/Triggers, preventing extra ADO.NET/EF overhead.

Topics.TitleEn: SQL Triggers (AFTER vs INSTEAD OF) & INSERTED / DELETED Tables
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Triggers (AFTER vs INSTEAD OF) وجداول INSERTED و DELETED
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Trigger**: كود بيشتغل تلقائيا عند حدث `INSERT` / `UPDATE` / `DELETE`.
• `AFTER Trigger`: بيشتغل **بعد** تنفيذ الأمر وتطبيق القيود (ممتاز للـ Audit Logs زي `PatientTransferLog`).
• `INSTEAD OF Trigger`: بيشتغل **بدل** الأمر الأصلي (الوحيد المسموح على Views المعقدة، أو منع الحذف).
• SQL Server بيوفر جدولين سحريين في الميموري: `INSERTED` (الصفوف الجديدة) و `DELETED` (الصفوف القديمة). في `UPDATE` بيكون القديم في `DELETED` والجديد في `INSERTED`!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• DML Triggers fire per statement (NOT per row!) — always write set-based joins against `INSERTED` and `DELETED`, NEVER `SELECT @id = Id FROM INSERTED` assuming 1 row!
• `AFTER`: runs post-statement & constraint checks (auditing, business enforcement).
• `INSTEAD OF`: overrides original DML action (works on Views too).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Assuming a trigger fires once per row (`DECLARE @x INT; SELECT @x = Col FROM INSERTED` silently drops multi-row updates!).
• Letting `RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS` or nested triggers cause infinite update loops.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `AFTER` vs `INSTEAD OF` triggers.
• What are `INSERTED` and `DELETED` populated with during `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE`?
• How do you prevent a trigger bug when 500 rows are updated at once?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: INSERT fills INSERTED; DELETE fills DELETED; UPDATE fills DELETED (old) + INSERTED (new).
ConventionKeys.ExampleSnippet: FROM INSERTED i JOIN DELETED d ...

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Triggers execute ONCE per statement, not per row. Join INSERTED/DELETED cleanly instead of scalar variables.
AFTER validates & executes post-DML (tables only); INSTEAD OF replaces the DML operation (tables & Views).

Topics.TitleEn: SQL Indexes: Clustered, Non-Clustered, INCLUDE Covering & Seek vs Scan
Topics.TitleAr: الفهارس Indexes (Clustered vs Non-Clustered و Covering Index)
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Clustered Index**: بيرتب بيانات الجدول **فعليا** على الديسك (B-Tree) -> الجدول يقبل **واحد فقط** (بيتعامل تلقائيا مع الـ `PRIMARY KEY` غالبا).
• **Non-Clustered Index**: هيكل منفصل عن الجدول فيه العمود المفهرس + مؤشر (Row Locator: Clustered Key لو فيه Clustered، أو RID لو Heap) -> مسموح لحد 999.
• **Covering Index (`INCLUDE`)**: بيحط أعمدة إضافية في الـ Leaf Level علشان الاستعلام يجيب كل بياناته من الفهرس بدون ما يعمل **Key Lookup** تقيل!
• **Index Seek** (سريع جدا بالـ B-Tree) vs **Index/Table Scan** (بيقرا الجدول كله!).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Clustered Index physically sorts table data pages (max 1 per table); Non-Clustered is a separate B-Tree pointing via Clustered Key or RID (up to 999).
• **Covering Index (`INCLUDE (col1, col2)`)** stores non-key payload columns at leaf pages to eliminate expensive Key Lookups.
• **Index Seek** navigates B-Tree directly; **Table/Index Scan** reads every page (`WHERE YEAR(Date) = 2025` prevents Seek -> non-SARGable!).
Topics.CodeSnippet:
-- Covering Index eliminating Key Lookup for frequent query
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Orders_Status_Date
ON Orders (Status, OrderDate DESC)
INCLUDE (CustomerId, TotalAmount);
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Wrapping indexed columns in functions like `WHERE YEAR(CreatedAt) = 2026` or leading wildcard `LIKE '%abc'` -> forces Index Scan instead of Index Seek (not SARGable!).
• Adding too many indexes slows down `INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` because every index B-Tree must be maintained.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Clustered vs Non-Clustered Index? How many per table?
• What is a Key Lookup and how does `INCLUDE` fix it?
• Explain Index Seek vs Index Scan and why `WHERE UPPER(Name) = ...` disables Seek.

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Clustered sorts the physical table rows (max 1); Non-Clustered stores separate B-Tree pointers.
Attaches SELECT columns at leaf level so query resolves without Key Lookup.
Avoid functions on indexed columns in WHERE; use range (>= and <) instead of YEAR(col)=2026 to keep Index Seek.

Topics.TitleEn: SQL Views (Standard, WITH CHECK OPTION) & Indexed Views (SCHEMABINDING)
Topics.TitleAr: الـ Views العادية والـ Indexed Views وشروط SCHEMABINDING
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ **Standard View**: مجرد Query محفوظ مبيخزنش داتا، بيسهل الاستعلامات ويحمي أعمدة معينة.
• `WITH ENCRYPTION`: يخفي كود التعريف. `WITH CHECK OPTION`: يمنع تعديل أو إضافة بيانات عبر الـ View تخالف شرط الـ `WHERE` جواها.
• **Indexed View**: بيتخزن فعليا على الديسك بعد عمل Unique Clustered Index عليه! شروطه الصارمة: لازم `WITH SCHEMABINDING`، وأسماء جداول ثنائية (`dbo.Table`)، ولو فيه `GROUP BY` لازم **`COUNT_BIG(*)`** (ومفيش `SELECT *` ولا Subqueries).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Standard View = virtual stored query (no stored rows). Options: `WITH CHECK OPTION` (validates DML against view WHERE), `WITH ENCRYPTION`.
• Indexed View = materialized B-Tree view requiring: `WITH SCHEMABINDING`, two-part table names (`dbo.Tbl`), `COUNT_BIG(*)` for aggregations, deterministic functions only, then `CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX`.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_ResearcherStats WITH SCHEMABINDING AS
SELECT R.Id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS PubCount
FROM dbo.Researcher R
INNER JOIN dbo.Publication P ON P.ResearcherId = R.Id
GROUP BY R.Id;
GO
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_vw_ResearcherStats ON dbo.vw_ResearcherStats(Id);
Topics.CommonMistakes: • Using `COUNT(*)` instead of `COUNT_BIG(*)` or omitting `dbo.` schema prefix when creating an Indexed View (SQL Server rejects the index!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What are the mandatory rules for creating an Indexed View in SQL Server?
• What does `WITH CHECK OPTION` prevent on a View?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Must use WITH SCHEMABINDING, two-part names (dbo.Table), no SELECT *, COUNT_BIG(*) for GROUP BY, and a Unique Clustered Index.
Blocks INSERT/UPDATE through a View if the modified row would violate the View's own WHERE clause.

Topics.TitleEn: Transactions (TCL), ACID Properties & TRY...CATCH Rollback
Topics.TitleAr: المعاملات Transactions (TCL) وخصائص ACID ومعالجة الأخطاء
Topics.SummaryAr:
• المعاملة هي وحدة عمل واحدة لا تتجزأ: يا كل الخطوات تنجح (`COMMIT`) يا كل الخطوات ترجع زي ما كانت (`ROLLBACK`).
• خصائص **ACID**: **A**tomicity (الكل أو لا شيء)، **C**onsistency (سلامة القيود)، **I**solation (عزل المعاملات المتزامنة)، **D**urability (ثبات بعد الـ Commit في الـ `.ldf` WAL).
• النمط الصح في SQL: `SET XACT_ABORT ON;` + `BEGIN TRAN` + `BEGIN TRY ... COMMIT TRAN` + `BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN; THROW; END CATCH`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• TCL: `BEGIN TRANSACTION`, `COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK`, `SAVE TRANSACTION`.
• ACID: **Atomicity** (all or nothing), **Consistency** (valid state/constraints), **Isolation** (concurrent tx interference rules), **Durability** (persisted via WAL `.ldf`).
• Always pair `BEGIN TRY ... BEGIN CATCH` checking `@@TRANCOUNT > 0` (and/or `XACT_ABORT ON`) before `ROLLBACK`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `ROLLBACK` blindly without checking `@@TRANCOUNT > 0`.
• Assuming `SELECT` inside `TRY/CATCH` automatically triggers rollback on error unless explicitly caught or `SET XACT_ABORT ON` is set.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Explain ACID with a bank transfer example.
• Write a safe `TRY...CATCH` transaction block.
• What does `@@TRANCOUNT` track?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Atomicity (all/none), Consistency (constraints preserved), Isolation (concurrency isolation), Durability (WAL persisted).
Check 'IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;' inside CATCH before THROW.

Topics.TitleEn: LINQ Foundations: var vs dynamic, Query/Method Syntax & Deferred Execution
Topics.TitleAr: أساسيات LINQ والفرق بين var و dynamic والتنفيذ المؤجل Deferred Execution
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **`var` vs `dynamic`**: الـ `var` نوعها بيتحدد وقت الـ Compile وبتفضل Static (تديك IntelliSense، ومينفعش تبقى Return type أو Field). الـ `dynamic` بيتحدد وقت الـ Runtime (CLR يتحقق عند التشغيل ومفيش Compile errors).
• **Deferred Execution (التنفيذ المؤجل)**: استعلامات زي `Where`/`Select`/`OrderBy` مبتشتغلش ساعة ما تكتبها! بتشتغل بس وقت الـ `foreach` أو `.ToList()` / `.Count()` / `.First()` (**Immediate Execution**).
• لو عدلت الـ `List` بين تعريف الـ Query وبين الـ `foreach`، الـ Query بيشوف التعديل الجديد!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `var`: compile-time type inference (strongly typed, required for anonymous types in LINQ); `dynamic`: runtime resolution via DLR (errors surface at runtime).
• Query syntax (`from x in src where ... select ...`) compiles down to Method syntax extension calls (`Enumerable`/`Queryable`).
• Deferred execution builds a pipeline recipe; Immediate execution (`.ToList()`, `.ToArray()`, `.Count()`, `.First()`, `.Sum()`) materializes results now.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
var nums = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
var query = nums.Where(n => n > 1); // Deferred: runs NOTHING yet!
nums.Add(4);                        // Mutated BEFORE execution
Console.WriteLine(query.Count());   // Immediate execution -> prints 3 (2, 3, 4)!
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `.ToList()` inside every chain step -> forces premature materialization in RAM.
• Calling `.Where()` then mutating list and enumerating twice (re-executes query from scratch!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `var` vs `dynamic` vs `object`.
• Explain Deferred Execution vs Immediate Execution with an example.
• Compare `IEnumerable<T>` (Local Sequence) vs `IQueryable<T>` (Remote Sequence Expression Trees).

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: var is compile-time statically typed (local only); dynamic bypasses compile checks and binds at runtime.
Where/Select/Skip/OrderBy/GroupBy execute lazily only when iterated or forced via ToList/First/Count.
ToList(), ToArray(), ToDictionary(), First(), Single(), Count(), Sum(), Any() trigger immediate evaluation.

Topics.TitleEn: Filtering (Where, OfType), Projection (Select, SelectMany) & Ordering
Topics.TitleAr: التصفية Filtering والـ Projection (Select/SelectMany) والترتيب
Topics.SummaryAr:
• `Where(x => ...)` و Indexed overload `Where((x, i) => ...)` (بيشتغل Local فقط!). `OfType<Dog>()` بيصفي العناصر اللي نوعها `Dog` بأمان.
• **`Select`** بيحول كل عنصر لعنصر تاني (1 -> 1). **`SelectMany`** بيفرد مجموعات متداخلة لقائمة واحدة مسطحة (1 -> N flattened!).
• في الترتيب: `OrderBy` -> وبعده لو عايز ترتيب ثانوي استخدم **`ThenBy`** / `ThenByDescending` (أوعى تكتب `OrderBy` مرتين وإلا التاني يلغي الأول!).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Filtering: `Where`, indexed `Where((item, idx) => ...)` (local only), `OfType<T>()`.
• Projection: `Select` (1-to-1 transform) vs `SelectMany` (1-to-many flatten nested lists into single sequence).
• Ordering: `OrderBy` -> chain with `ThenBy` / `ThenByDescending` (`Reverse()` flips sequence).
Topics.CodeSnippet:
var flatOrders = customers.SelectMany(c => c.Orders);

var sorted = ProductList
    .Where(p => p.UnitsInStock > 0)
    .OrderBy(p => p.Category)
    .ThenByDescending(p => p.UnitPrice); // DO NOT chain two OrderBy calls!
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `.OrderBy(x => x.A).OrderBy(x => x.B)` -> the second `OrderBy` completely overrides the first sort! Must use `.ThenBy()`.
• Confusing `Select` (returns `IEnumerable<List<T>>`) vs `SelectMany` (returns `IEnumerable<T>`).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Difference between `Select` and `SelectMany`?
• What happens if you call `.OrderBy(a).OrderBy(b)` instead of `.OrderBy(a).ThenBy(b)`?
• What does `OfType<T>()` do on mixed collections like `ArrayList` or inheritance hierarchies?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Select transforms N elements into N results; SelectMany flattens nested sequences into one flat stream.
Use ThenBy/ThenByDescending for secondary sorts; a second OrderBy resets the primary sort.
Where((x, index) => ...) and Select((x, index) => ...) work in LINQ-to-Objects ONLY, not EF SQL.

Topics.TitleEn: Element Operators, Aggregation & Quantifiers
Topics.TitleAr: عوامل العناصر First/Single والتجميع MinBy/MaxBy والـ Quantifiers
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **`First` / `FirstOrDefault`**: يجيب الأول. **`Single` / `SingleOrDefault`**: بيفرض أن فيه **عنصر واحد بس** مطابِق (ممتاز للبحث بالـ Unique Id؛ لو أكتر من 1 يضرب Exception حتى مع `OrDefault`!).
• في C# `.NET 6+`: `MaxBy` / `MinBy` بيرجعوا الـ **Object كله** صاحب أعلى/أقل قيمة عكس `Max`/`Min` اللي بترجع الرقم فقط!
• **`Any()`** أسرع بكتير من `.Count() > 0` عشان بيوقف أول ما يلاقي أول عنصر! `All()` بيتحقق من الكل (`{}` الفاضية بترجع `true`!). `Average()` على فاضي بيضرب `InvalidOperationException`.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• `First[OrDefault]`, `Last[OrDefault]`, `Single[OrDefault]` (`Single` throws if >1 match even with `OrDefault`!), `ElementAt`, `DefaultIfEmpty`.
• Aggregation: `Count`, `Sum`, `Average` (throws on empty!), `Min`/`Max` (scalar) vs `MinBy`/`MaxBy` (returns full object!), `Aggregate(seed, (acc, x) => ...)`.
• Quantifiers (immediate bool): `Any()`, `All()`, `Contains()`, `SequenceEqual()`.
Topics.CodeSnippet:
var user = users.SingleOrDefault(u => u.Id == 5); // Throws ONLY if > 1 user has Id=5
var topEmp = employees.MaxBy(e => e.Salary);    // Returns Employee object, not decimal
bool hasActive = products.Any(p => p.IsActive); // Better than Count() > 0!
int folded = new[] { 1, 2, 3 }.Aggregate(10, (acc, x) => acc - x); // 10-1-2-3 = 4
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Calling `SingleOrDefault` expecting it to silently pick first of duplicates (it throws `InvalidOperationException`!).
• Using `.Where(...).Count() > 0` instead of `.Any(...)`.
• Calling `.Average()` or `.Min()` on an empty non-nullable `int` sequence without `.DefaultIfEmpty()`.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `First`, `FirstOrDefault`, `Single`, and `SingleOrDefault`.
• Compare `Max` vs `MaxBy`.
• Why prefer `Any()` over `Count() > 0` in EF Core / SQL?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: SingleOrDefault returns default for 0 items, THROWS if >1 match; FirstOrDefault returns first match without throwing.
Any() generates SQL EXISTS and stops at first row; Count() scans all matching rows.
Returns the entity object having the extreme property value instead of only the value.

Topics.TitleEn: Partitioning (Take/Skip/Chunk), Set Ops, GroupBy, Zip & LINQ Joins
Topics.TitleAr: التقسيم Take/Skip/Chunk والمجموعات و GroupBy و LINQ Joins
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **Partitioning**: `Skip((page-1)*size).Take(size)` للـ Pagination، و `Chunk(n)` بتقسم لمجموعات حجم كل واحدة n، و `TakeWhile`/`SkipWhile` بتقف عند أول مخالفة.
• **Set Ops**: `Distinct`, `DistinctBy`, `Union`, `UnionBy`, `Intersect`, `Except` (مع الكائنات المخصصة لازم تقارن Key بـ `*By` أو تمرر `IEqualityComparer<T>`).
• **`GroupBy`** بيعمل Deferred Execution بـ `IGrouping<TKey, TElement>`، بينما **`ToLookup`** بيعمل Immediate In-Memory Hash.
• **LINQ Joins**: Query Syntax بيستخدم كلمة `equals` مش `==`! ومع .NET 10 بقى فيه `.LeftJoin()` مباشرة بدل لفة `GroupJoin + SelectMany + DefaultIfEmpty` القديمة!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Partitioning: `Take`, `Skip`, `Chunk(n)`, `TakeWhile`, `SkipWhile`.
• Set Ops: `Distinct[By]`, `Union[By]`, `Intersect[By]`, `Except[By]`.
• Grouping & Combining: `GroupBy` (deferred), `ToLookup` (immediate), `Zip`.
• Joins: `Join` (Inner), `GroupJoin` (1:M grouped), `.NET 10 LeftJoin()`, classic `GroupJoin + SelectMany + DefaultIfEmpty`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Writing `on a.Id == b.Id` in query syntax join (doesn't compile — must use `equals` keyword!).
• Calling `.Distinct()` on a `class` without `IEquatable`/`GetHashCode` or `.DistinctBy(x => x.Id)` (compares memory addresses!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare `GroupBy` vs `ToLookup`.
• How was Left Outer Join written in LINQ before .NET 10 vs .NET 10's `LeftJoin()`?
• Why does `Distinct()` on reference class objects require `DistinctBy` or overriding `Equals` + `GetHashCode`?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: LINQ query-syntax 'join' mandates the 'equals' keyword (outerKey equals innerKey); '==' fails to compile.
.NET 10 adds .LeftJoin(); earlier versions chain GroupJoin + SelectMany + DefaultIfEmpty().
Classes compare by reference in Distinct(); use DistinctBy(x => x.Key) or custom IEqualityComparer.

Topics.TitleEn: ORM Architecture, DbContext, DbSet & Code First Migrations Lifecycle
Topics.TitleAr: معمارية الـ ORM و DbContext و دورة حياة الـ Migrations
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **ORM (Object-Relational Mapping)**: جسر بين جداول الـ SQL وكلاسات الـ C#. `DbContext` هو الجلسة مع الداتابيز و `DbSet<T>` يمثل كل جدول.
• **Code First Migrations**: (1) تعدل الـ Entities/Configs -> (2) `Add-Migration Name` (بيحسب الفرق مقارنة بالـ `ModelSnapshot` ويولد `Up()` و `Down()`) -> (3) `Update-Database` (بيطبق اللي متنفذش في جدول `__EFMigrationsHistory`).
• في المشاريع الجديدة الـ Code First بيخلي التعديلات متتبعة في Git عكس DB First.
Topics.SummaryEn:
• EF Core parses LINQ expression trees via the Database Provider (`SqlServer`) into native SQL and materializes rows back into tracked C# entities.
• Migrations compare current C# model against `*ModelSnapshot.cs`; `__EFMigrationsHistory` guarantees each migration runs once.
• PMC vs CLI: `Add-Migration` / `dotnet ef migrations add`; `Update-Database` / `dotnet ef database update`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Deleting migration `.cs` files manually after `Update-Database` instead of `Update-Database PrevMigration` then `Remove-Migration`.
• Running `Update-Database` after editing a model without running `Add-Migration` first (the snapshot/DB schema won't change!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Explain Code First vs Database First and when to use each.
• What are `ModelSnapshot.cs` and `__EFMigrationsHistory`?
• How does `Up()` vs `Down()` work when rolling back a migration?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: A property named 'Id' or '<ClassName>Id' automatically becomes the Primary Key (+ IDENTITY if int/long).
Unconfigured C# string properties map to NVARCHAR(MAX) in SQL Server unless [MaxLength] or HasMaxLength() is set.
__EFMigrationsHistory tracks already-applied migrations so Update-Database never re-runs them twice.

Questions.Prompt: If you add a new property `public string Bio { get; set; }` to your Entity class and immediately run `Update-Database`, the new column is added to SQL Server.
Questions.Explanation: You must create a migration (`Add-Migration` / `dotnet ef migrations add`) first; `Update-Database` only executes unapplied migration files.
Questions.SourceCitation: 06 Entity Framework Core\Hossam Mostafa\Session 01\Presentation\EF Core - Session 01 .pptx S41

Questions.Prompt: Given `public class Student { public int Id { get; set; } public string Nickname { get; set; } = null!; }`, what SQL Server column is created by EF Core conventions?
Questions.Explanation: Non-nullable C# `string` with NRTs enabled creates `NOT NULL`, and with no `[MaxLength]`/Fluent `HasMaxLength` EF defaults strings to `nvarchar(max)`!
Questions.SourceCitation: 06 Entity Framework Core\Hossam Mostafa\Session 01\Presentation\EF Core - Session 01 .pptx S62-S63

Topics.TitleEn: 3-Tier Configuration Precedence, IEntityTypeConfiguration, Shadow & Owned Props
Topics.TitleAr: ترتيب أولوية الإعدادات (Fluent API > Annotations > Conventions) و Shadow/Owned
Topics.SummaryAr:
• ترتيب الانتصار لو حصل تعارض:
  **1. Fluent API** (`OnModelCreating` أو `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`) دايما يكسب الكل!
  **2. Data Annotations** (`[Key]`, `[Required]`, `[MaxLength]`, `[Column]`, `[NotMapped]`).
  **3. Conventions** (الافتراضي من اسماء الكلاسات).
• بنفصل كل جدول في كلاس `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` ونجمعهم بـ `modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(...)`.
• **Shadow Property**: عمود موجود في الجدول ومتتبع بالـ ChangeTracker ومش موجود كـ Property في الكلاس. **Owned Entity (`[Owned]`/`OwnsOne`)**: كائن قيمة زي `Address` بيتفرد أعمدته جوه جدول الـ Parent!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Precedence: **Fluent API > Data Annotations > Conventions**.
• Keeps Entities clean POCOs: put mapping in `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` + `modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly())`.
• Note: `[Key]` on 2 properties does NOT make a composite key in EF Core — use `HasKey(x => new { x.A, x.B })` (or `[PrimaryKey(nameof(A), nameof(B))]` in EF 7+).
• **Shadow Properties** & **Owned Entity Types (`OwnsOne`)**.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Leaving `decimal` properties unconfigured -> SQL Server defaults to `decimal(18,2)` with EF warning; always set `.HasColumnType("decimal(10,2)")` or `.HasPrecision(10,2)`.
• Putting `[Key]` on two properties expecting a composite PK -> throws runtime error!
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• State the 3-tier EF Core configuration priority hierarchy.
• Why use `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` + `ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly`?
• What are Shadow Properties and Owned Entity Types (`OwnsOne`)?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Fluent API ALWAYS overrides Data Annotations, which override default Conventions.
Putting [Key] on two properties throws; configure composite PK via HasKey(x => new { x.A, x.B }) in Fluent API.
Auto-discovers and registers all IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes from an assembly cleanly.
Flattens value-object properties (e.g. Employee.Address) as columns inside the owner's table.

Questions.Prompt: Putting `[Key]` attribute on two different properties inside an EF Core entity class creates a composite primary key.
Questions.Explanation: [Key] works only for a single key. Use Fluent API `HasKey(x => new { x.Key1, x.Key2 })` (or `[PrimaryKey]`).

Questions.Prompt: A property has `[MaxLength(50)]` Data Annotation AND `builder.Property(p => p.Name).HasMaxLength(200)` in Fluent API. What column length is generated?
Questions.Explanation: Fluent API always has Priority #1 and overrides both Data Annotations and Conventions.

Topics.TitleEn: Relationships (1:1, 1:M, M:N, Self-Reference) & DeleteBehavior
Topics.TitleAr: ربط العلاقات في EF Core (1:1, 1:M, M:N, Self-Reference) و DeleteBehavior
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الـ **Foreign Key** دايما في جدول الـ **Dependent (Many)**. EF Core يتعرف على الـ FK أوتوماتيك لو اسمه `<NavProp>Id` أو `<NavProp><PK>`.
• في **1:1** لازم تحديد الطرف التابع بـ `.HasForeignKey<Dependent>(x => x.ParentId)`!
• في **M:N**: لو معندكش بيانات إضافية حط `ICollection<T>` في الطرفين و EF يعمل جدول الربط لوحده. لو فيه عمود زيادة زي `Grade` أو `EnrolledOn` لازم تعمل Join Entity وتفكها لـ **اتنين 1:M**.
• في **Self-Reference** (زي `SupervisorId`): لازم FK يبقى Nullable `int?` عشان الـ Root مالوش مشرف!
• **DeleteBehavior**: لو FK Required الافتراضي `Cascade`؛ لو Optional الافتراضي `ClientSetNull`!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• FK sits on Dependent side. Explicit `HasForeignKey<Dependent>(...)` required for 1:1 relationships.
• M:N: implicit skip-navigation (`ICollection` on both sides) vs explicit Join Entity when payload columns (`Grade`, `JoinedDate`) are needed.
• Self-Reference uses nullable `int? SupervisorId` + `.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict)` to prevent SQL Server multiple-cascade-paths errors.
• Required FK defaults to `DeleteBehavior.Cascade`; Optional FK defaults to `ClientSetNull` / `SetNull`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Forgetting `<Dependent>` generic type parameter in `.HasForeignKey<UserProfile>(p => p.UserId)` for 1:1 (ambiguous dependent!).
• Leaving `DeleteBehavior.Cascade` on multiple foreign keys to the same table -> SQL Server throws 'may cause cycles or multiple cascade paths'.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• What FK naming conventions does EF Core detect automatically?
• When must you convert an implicit M:N collection into an explicit Join Entity?
• What is the default `DeleteBehavior` for Required vs Optional FKs?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Discovers <NavName>Id, <NavName><PK>, <PrincipalType>Id, or <PrincipalType><PK> automatically.
Non-nullable (Required) FK -> Cascade delete; Nullable (Optional) FK -> ClientSetNull / SetNull.
1:1 requires specifying which entity holds the FK via HasForeignKey<Dependent>(d => d.PrincipalId).

Topics.TitleEn: Entity States, ChangeTracker, Disconnected Update() vs Attach & ExecuteUpdate/Delete
Topics.TitleAr: حالات الكائن Entity States و AsNoTracking و ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete
Topics.SummaryAr:
• الحالات الخمسة في الـ `ChangeTracker`: `Detached` (غير متتبع)، `Unchanged` (متجاب من داتابيز وماتعدلش)، `Added` (`INSERT`)، `Modified` (`UPDATE` للأعمدة المتعدلة فقط لو متتبع)، `Deleted` (`DELETE`).
• أخطر فخ في Disconnected Entities: لو عملت `context.Update(dto)` وفيه أعمدة مبعتهاش، هيعلم عليها كلها Modified ويمسح قيمها بـ NULL! الحل الصح يا إما تجيب الكائن وتحدثه يا `Attach` + `Property(...).IsModified = true`.
• للقراءة فقط استخدم **`.AsNoTracking()`** (بيوفر رام و CPU ومش بيعمل Snapshot).
• **Bulk Ops (EF 7+)**: `.ExecuteUpdate()` و `.ExecuteDelete()` بينفذوا SQL فوري في الداتابيز من غير ما يحملوا الكائنات في الميموري ولا يحتاجوا `SaveChanges()`!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• 5 Entity States: `Detached`, `Unchanged`, `Added`, `Modified`, `Deleted`. Calling `Add()` sets state = `Added`; SQL only runs on `SaveChanges()`!
• Tracked update generates `UPDATE` for ONLY changed columns; disconnected `_context.Update(entity)` overwrites ALL columns!
• `.AsNoTracking()` returns `Detached` objects (ideal for read-only views/APIs).
• EF 7+ `.ExecuteUpdate()` / `.ExecuteDelete()` execute immediate set-based SQL without `SaveChanges()`.
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Modifying an entity loaded with `.AsNoTracking()` and calling `SaveChanges()` -> nothing is saved to the DB!
• Calling `SaveChanges()` expecting `ExecuteDeleteAsync()` to defer until `SaveChanges()` (`ExecuteDeleteAsync` executes immediately!).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Trace the 5 EF Core Entity States.
• Why is `Update()` dangerous on partial/disconnected objects?
• Compare `AsNoTracking()` vs `AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution()`.
• How do `ExecuteUpdate` and `ExecuteDelete` work and do they trigger ChangeTracker?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Bypasses ChangeTracker snapshot memory for read-only queries; edits + SaveChanges() won't save.
_db.Update(obj) marks EVERY property Modified; partial DTO objects will overwrite missing fields with null/default!
EF 7+ executes immediate SQL without loading entities into RAM or calling SaveChanges().

Topics.TitleEn: Loading Strategies (Eager, Explicit, Lazy), N+1 Query Problem & AsSplitQuery
Topics.TitleAr: طرق تحميل البيانات (Eager/Explicit/Lazy) ومشكلة الـ N+1 و AsSplitQuery
Topics.SummaryAr:
• افتراضيا في EF Core: الـ **Navigation Properties مبتتحملش تلقائيا** (بتيجي `null` / فاضية)!
• **Eager Loading (`.Include().ThenInclude()`)**: بيجيب العلاقات مع نفس الاستعلام بـ SQL `JOIN` (يدعم كمان Filtered Include من EF 5+).
• **Explicit Loading**: بتحمل العلاقة بعدين وقت الحاجة بس عبر `Entry(p).Reference(x => x.Cat).Load()` أو `.Collection(...).Query().Where(...)`.
• **Lazy Loading** (`Proxies` + `virtual` nav props): يحمل أوتوماتيك عند أول لمسة — لكن بيعمل كارثة **N+1 Query Problem** (100 طلب يعملوا 101 Query!).
• لما يبقى فيه كذا `Include` لـ Collections ويعمل Cartesian Explosion، استخدم **`.AsSplitQuery()`**!
Topics.SummaryEn:
• Navigation properties stay null/empty unless loaded!
• Eager (`Include` / `ThenInclude` / filtered `Include(c => c.Products.Where(...))`): single query (or split queries via `.AsSplitQuery()` to stop Cartesian Explosion!).
• Explicit (`_context.Entry(x).Reference(...).Load()`, `.Collection(...).Query()`).
• Lazy (virtual navs + `UseLazyLoadingProxies()`): hides SQL inside loops -> **N+1 problem**!
Topics.CodeSnippet:
var orders = await _db.Orders
    .AsNoTracking()
    .Include(o => o.Customer)
    .Include(o => o.Items.Where(i => i.Qty > 0))
        .ThenInclude(i => i.Product)
    .AsSplitQuery() // Prevents Cartesian Explosion on multiple collection Includes!
    .ToListAsync();
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Enabling Lazy Loading in API/MVC and looping over 500 rows reading `order.Customer.Name` -> fires 501 round-trip SQL queries!
• Chaining multiple `.Include()` calls to giant child collections without `.AsSplitQuery()` -> row duplication explosion.
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare Eager, Explicit, and Lazy Loading and when to pick each.
• Explain the N+1 query problem and how Eager Loading solves it.
• What is Cartesian Explosion and how does `.AsSplitQuery()` fix it?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: EF Core NEVER loads navigation properties by default; they are null/empty unless Include, Load, or Lazy Proxies are used.
Lazy Loading inside a loop over N rows executes 1 + N database queries; fix with Eager Include() or Select() projection.
Splits multi-collection Include() into separate SELECT statements to prevent Cartesian Explosion row duplication.

Topics.TitleEn: Inheritance Mapping Strategies: TPH, TPT & TPC (TPCC)
Topics.TitleAr: استراتيجيات وراثة الجداول في EF Core (TPH vs TPT vs TPC)
Topics.SessionLabel: EF Core Khaled Inheritance & Hossam S04
Topics.SummaryAr:
• **TPH (Table Per Hierarchy — الافتراضي)**: جدول واحد بيجمع الأب وكل الأبناء + عمود **`Discriminator`** بيميز النوع. أسرع قراءة (مفيش JOINs)، لكن أعمدة الأبناء بتكون Nullable في الجدول.
• **TPT (Table Per Type)**: جدول للأب وجدول منفصل لكل ابن (`.ToTable("FullTimeEmployees")` أو `UseTptMappingStrategy()`). أنضف Normalization لكن كل قراءة محتاجة `JOIN`!
• **TPC / TPCC (Table Per Concrete Class)**: جدول مستقل تماما لكل ابن شايل أعمدة الأب مع أعمدته (`UseTpcMappingStrategy()`). مفيش `Discriminator` ولا `NULL`s للـ sibling، والقراءة من الابن سريعة بدون JOIN (وبتربط الـ Abstract base بـ `UNION ALL`).
Topics.SummaryEn:
• **TPH** (Default): 1 table + `Discriminator` column; fastest polymorphic queries (no joins), requires nullable child-specific columns.
• **TPT** (`ToTable(...)` / `UseTptMappingStrategy()`): 1 table per type (normalized, zero extra nulls, slow multi-JOIN queries).
• **TPC / TPCC** (`UseTpcMappingStrategy()`): 1 table per concrete class with duplicated base columns (uses `UNION ALL` for base DbSet queries + sequences for unique PKs).
Topics.CommonMistakes:
• Expecting EF Core to create separate tables automatically per subclass without calling `ToTable()`, `UseTptMappingStrategy()`, or `UseTpcMappingStrategy()` (EF defaults to TPH!).
• Using `IDENTITY` keys with TPC without a shared DB sequence (EF 7+ `UseTpcMappingStrategy()` manages a sequence automatically).
Topics.InterviewQuestions:
• Compare TPH, TPT, and TPC in EF Core (tables created, Discriminator, NULLs, query performance).
• Which strategy does EF Core use by default, and which is usually fastest at runtime?

ConventionKeys.ShortRule: Single table with 'Discriminator' column; fast queries, nullable child columns.
Separate table per base & derived class joined via PK/FK; UseTptMappingStrategy() / ToTable().
Separate table only per concrete child carrying inherited columns; UseTpcMappingStrategy() uses sequence.
